name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.layersAuxC_le
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat),
  DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Ok N →
    ∀ (L : Nat),
      (∀ (x : ν), Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) x → LE.le.{0} (c x) L) →
        ∀ (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)),
          (∀ (a : Prod.{0, 0} ν ν),
              Membership.mem.{0, 0} U a → Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N) a) →
            LE.le.{0} (List.length.{0} U) (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N)) →
              ∀ (k : Nat) (seen front : List.{0} ν),
                List.Nodup.{0} seen →
                  List.Nodup.{0} front →
                    (∀ (y : ν), Membership.mem.{0, 0} front y → y ∉ seen) →
                      (∀ (y : ν),
                          Membership.mem.{0, 0} seen y →
                            Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) y) →
                        (∀ (y : ν),
                            Membership.mem.{0, 0} front y →
                              Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) y) →
                          LE.le.{0} k (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N)) →
                            LE.le.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.layersAuxC N c U k seen front)
                              (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1)
                                (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.layerRoundB
                                  (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N))
                                  (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N)) L))

source.code:
theorem layersAuxC_le (hN : N.Ok) (L : ℕ) (hL : ∀ x ∈ N.nodes, c x ≤ L) (U : List (ν × ν))
    (hU : ∀ a ∈ U, a ∈ N.arcs) (hm : U.length ≤ N.arcs.length) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (seen front : List ν), seen.Nodup → front.Nodup → (∀ y ∈ front, y ∉ seen) →
      (∀ y ∈ seen, y ∈ N.nodes) → (∀ y ∈ front, y ∈ N.nodes) →
      k ≤ N.nodes.length →
      N.layersAuxC c U k seen front ≤ (k + 1) * layerRoundB N.nodes.length N.arcs.length L
  | 0, seen, front, _, hfn, _, _, hf, _ => by
      simp only [layersAuxC, layerRoundB]
      have := N.length_le_of_nodup_subset front hfn hf
      nlinarith
  | k + 1, seen, front, hsn, hfn, hdisj, hs, hf, hk => by
      simp only [layersAuxC]
      have hsl := N.length_le_of_nodup_subset seen hsn hs
      have hfl := N.length_le_of_nodup_subset front hfn hf
      have hfuel : natC (k + 1) ≤ 2 * N.nodes.length + 3 := by
        have := natC_le_linear (k + 1); omega
      have h1 := N.newFrontC_le c hN L hL U hU hm seen front hs hf hsl hfl
      have h2 := layersAuxC_le hN L hL U hU hm k (seen ++ front) (N.newFront U seen front)
        (List.nodup_append.mpr ⟨hsn, hfn, fun a ha b hb hab => hdisj b hb (hab ▸ ha)⟩)
        (hN.nodes_nodup.filter _)
        (fun y hy => by
          rw [N.mem_newFront] at hy
          simp only [List.mem_append, not_or]
          exact ⟨hy.2.1, hy.2.2.1⟩)
        (fun y hy => by
          rw [List.mem_append] at hy
          rcases hy with hy | hy
          · exact hs y hy
          · exact hf y hy)
        (fun y hy => ((N.mem_newFront U _ _ y).mp hy).1) (by omega)
      unfold layerRoundB at h2 ⊢
      nlinarith
